topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's scope on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Plasticity in Cancer Progression
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how cancer evolves through sequential clonal selection of driving mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how tissue differentiation hierarchies and the cell of origin influence cancer initiation and tumor-propagating capacity.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Influences on Tumor Growth
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate how inflammatory stimuli and supportive stromal environments provide the permissive signals required for tumor outgrowth and maintenance.

topics.label: Experimental and Computational Methods in Cancer Evolution Research
topics.groupedBecause: It describes the analytical tools and experimental approaches used to investigate tumor evolution and cell-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Multi-Factorial Evolutionary Framework of Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how genetic alterations, cell intrinsic properties, and environmental conditions converge to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Session Preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the presentation and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
